items.quote: Furthermore, promoter Mr. Amit Jain and Whole-Time Director Mr. Sandeep Jain and Mr. Arpit Jain are forgoing their dividends to enhance shareholder value.

items.statement: Operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion at 76% on LTM basis, above 70% target
items.quote: On an LTM basis, the OCF to EBITDA is at 76%, higher than the target that we have set for ourselves at 70%, so we'll continue to work in terms of continuing to deliver 70% plus on an LTM basis on OCF to EBITDA.

items.statement: DSO improved to 73 days from 75 days last quarter
items.quote: DSO for the quarter is at 73 days. We had called out last quarter that 75 days at the beginning of the quarter was an aberration and this will come down, and that's what is reflected in the current quarter in terms of the 73 days.

items.statement: Board proposed a bonus issue of 1:5, i.e., 1 share for every 5 shares held, subject to shareholder approval.
items.quote: I am pleased to announce that today the board has proposed a bonus issue of 1: 5, i.e. 1 share for every 5 shares held, subject to the approval of the shareholders.
